legal_ref: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, art. 291 alin. (1), as amended by Legea nr. 141/2025, art. II pct. 42 (MO nr. 699 din 25.07.2025)
quote: (1) Cota standard se aplică asupra bazei de impozitare pentru operațiunile impozabile care nu sunt scutite de taxă sau care nu sunt supuse cotei reduse, iar nivelul acesteia este 21% — The standard rate applies to taxable operations that are not exempt or subject to the reduced rate; its level is 21%.
source_title: ANAF – Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated (last update OUG nr. 38/2026); start date per ANAF DGRFP Brașov note 'Modificări aduse Legii nr. 227/2015 ... prin Legea nr. 141/2025 – în vigoare cu 1 august 2025' (https://static.anaf.ro/static/10/Brasov/Brasov/tva_2025.pdf)

reduced_rates.scope: medicines for human use; foodstuffs and non-alcoholic drinks (excl. NC 2202 drinks, high added-sugar foods, food supplements); water supply and sewerage; irrigation water; agricultural inputs (fertilisers, pesticides, seeds) and agricultural services; books, newspapers, school textbooks (incl. electronic); admission to museums, castles, monuments, zoos and botanical gardens; firewood and wood pellets; district heating in the cold season for households and listed institutions; social housing (care homes, children's homes); hotel accommodation and camping; restaurant and catering (excl. alcohol and NC 2202 drinks)

transitional only: one dwelling (max 120 m², max 600,000 lei) bought by an individual between 1 Aug 2025 and 31 Jul 2026 where an advance-payment contract was signed before 1 Aug 2025 (Legea 141/2025 art. III) — window has now closed

notes: Previous standard rate 19% (from 1 Jan 2017). From 1 Aug 2025 Legea 141/2025 raised the standard rate from 19% to 21% and merged the 5% and 9% reduced rates into a single 11% rate. Exports and intra-EU supplies exempt with right of deduction. TEDB (snapshot 2026-07-01) shows 21% standard and 11% reduced, consistent.
unverified: Commencement date 2025-08-01 taken from ANAF regional guidance notes (DGRFP Brașov and Ploiești) rather than the text of Legea 141/2025 itself — legislatie.just.ro was unreachable
